versions.name: Camp Alpine
versions.address: Kandersteg International Scout Centre (KISC), Kandersteg, Switzerland

features.note: Summit, the camp's specialty adventure track for older, more experienced Scouts.

versions.summary: Transatlantic Council nationally-accredited Scouts BSA resident camp at Kandersteg International Scout Centre in the Swiss Alps, offering Base Camp, Ascent merit badge, and Summit high-adventure tracks.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/802-CampAlpine2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
